annotations.title: List a company's SEC review correspondence as it was public

description: Return the company's SEC staff letters (UPLOAD) and its letters to the staff (CORRESP), each with the date EDGAR records for it and the business day EDGAR first published it. The SEC publishes review correspondence after a review closes, often months after the letters were sent, so each letter is admitted from the day after it was published: an as_of date or timestamp returns only what was public by then. Deterministic ordering: latest publication first (public_date descending), with accession_id ascending as the tie-break. EDGAR's daily indexes list correspondence from 2005-05-12, so an earlier as_of returns none.

as_of.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a timestamp with an offset. Returns letters published before that date, or before the timestamp's day in New York time; letters published that day are excluded. Omitted, the read is as of now.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

form_type.description: Only staff letters (UPLOAD) or only company letters (CORRESP).

from.description: Inclusive lower bound on the publication date.

page_size.description: Items per page, 1 to 200, default 50. A larger value is served as 200, and the response's page_size reports the size used.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound on the publication date.
